claims.variance: Hamiltonian dispersion, not a ground-energy error bound

field_convention: F_Q=E_Q-h*Q/2; h_lower=E3-E1 fixed; h_upper=E5-E3; total exchange energies, J=1

execution.resource_cpu_method: difference of cumulative child ru_utime and ru_stime before launch and after exit
execution.resource_measurement_scope: single worker reaped by this launcher; includes descendant usage only as accounted by the OS
execution.resource_peak_rss_method: post-exit ru_maxrss high water; available only with no prior child usage

refinement.profile_difference_convention: old minus new at matching coordinates; signed mean follows this convention
refinement.spatial_change_scope: profiles measured at cumulative8 and cumulative10 only; no attribution to sweep9-to10 alone

y_shift_only_comparison.interpretation: circumference domain-position comparison of finite trials; not full VBC template matching, an energy/phase selection criterion, or a convergence test
y_shift_only_comparison.minimum_tie_convention: all exact floating-point minima retained separately for Sz and bond
y_shift_only_comparison.shift_convention: left(x,y,s) minus right(x,(y+shift) mod Ly,s); translate both endpoints of each bond

Q3_to_Q5_after.interpretation: signed finite-trial charge redistribution; no edge-localization or bulk plateau inference
Q3_to_Q5_after.normalization: column sums of Sz(higher Q)-Sz(lower Q); no clipping, absolute value, or renormalization

Q3_to_Q5_before.interpretation: signed finite-trial charge redistribution; no edge-localization or bulk plateau inference
Q3_to_Q5_before.normalization: column sums of Sz(higher Q)-Sz(lower Q); no clipping, absolute value, or renormalization

Q5_10_minus_8.interpretation: signed finite-trial charge redistribution; no edge-localization or bulk plateau inference
Q5_10_minus_8.normalization: column sums of Sz(Q5,cumulative10)-Sz(Q5,cumulative8); no clipping or renormalization

fixed_Q1_to_Q3.interpretation: signed finite-trial charge redistribution; no edge-localization or bulk plateau inference
fixed_Q1_to_Q3.normalization: column sums of Sz(higher Q)-Sz(lower Q); no clipping, absolute value, or renormalization

study: NN N27 Q5 chi256 cumulative8_to10; Q1/Q3 cumulative8 fixed
verification_scope: saved scalar/profile arithmetic, checkpoint byte hashes and metadata, archived analysis sources; no MPS load/contraction or ED; backend digest maps compared but backend files not rehashed
